plugins.name: asodev-skills
plugins.description: ASO.dev skills for App Store Optimization, App Store Connect workflows, Google Play ASO, metadata, localization, reviews, monetization, subscriptions, pricing, In-App Events, featuring nominations, local AI Companion MCP workflows, and ASO.dev public API workflows.

skills.name: android-aso
skills.description: Use when the user wants Google Play Store or Android ASO: Play listing title, short description, full description, keyword strategy, feature graphic, screenshots, ratings/reviews, Play Store Experiments, localization, or Google Play-specific metadata via ASO.dev.
skills.description_zh: 通过 ASO.dev 优化 Google Play/Android 的标题、短长描述、关键词、主宣传图、截图、评分评价、商店实验、本地化及专属元数据。

skills.name: app-analytics
skills.description: Use when the user wants to interpret ASO.dev Measurements or App Store Connect metrics: downloads, impressions, product page views, conversion, revenue, retention, sessions, active devices, ratings, reviews, release markers, experiment impact, or before/after ASO performance.
skills.description_zh: 解释 ASO.dev Measurements 或 App Store Connect 的下载、曝光、产品页浏览、转化、收入、留存、会话、活跃设备、评分评价、版本标记、实验及 ASO 前后效果。

skills.name: app-context
skills.description: Use to read, create, or update ASO.dev per-app project context before metadata, localization, keywords, screenshots, IAP, subscriptions, pricing, In-App Events, nominations, or review work.
skills.description_zh: 在元数据、本地化、关键词、截图、内购、订阅、定价、应用内活动、推荐提名或评价工作前，读取、创建或更新 ASO.dev 单应用上下文。

skills.name: app-store-connect-mcp
skills.description: Use whenever an ASO.dev skill needs the local localhost AI Companion MCP: reading/filling Apple or Google metadata, nominations, In-App Events, reviews, review replies/complaints, project context, or validation.
skills.description_zh: 为 ASO.dev 技能提供本地 localhost AI Companion MCP 接入，读取填写 Apple/Google 元数据、提名、应用内活动、评价回复申诉、项目上下文及验证。

skills.name: apple-search-ads-intelligence
skills.description: Use when the user wants Apple Search Ads or ASO.dev Ads Intelligence analysis: app ads, keyword ads, competitor ad creatives, custom product pages in ads, share of voice, auction insights, SAP as paid-intent signal, or paid/organic keyword alignment.
skills.description_zh: 分析 Apple Search Ads 或 ASO.dev Ads Intelligence 的应用关键词广告、竞品创意、广告自定义产品页、声量份额、竞价洞察、付费意图 SAP 信号及付费自然关键词对齐。

skills.name: aso-audit
skills.description: Use when the user wants a full ASO audit or health check for an app: metadata, keyword coverage, cross-localization, screenshots, reviews, ratings, update history, In-App Events, IAP/subscriptions, CPP/PPO, competitors, rankings, or ASO.dev ASO Check interpretation.
skills.description_zh: 全面审计应用 ASO 健康，涵盖元数据、关键词、跨地区本地化、截图、评价、版本、应用内活动、内购订阅、CPP/PPO、竞品和排名，以及解释 ASO.dev ASO Check。

skills.name: asodev-public-api
skills.description: Use when the user asks about ASO.dev public APIs, Developer API, Partners API, OpenAPI docs, API keys, integration endpoints, request/response schemas, or how an external system should call ASO.dev outside the local AI Companion MCP.
skills.description_zh: 解释 ASO.dev 公共 Developer/Partners API、OpenAPI、API 密钥、端点及请求响应模式，指导外部系统在本地 AI Companion MCP 之外调用。

skills.name: competitor-analysis
skills.description: Use when the user wants to analyze App Store or Google Play competitors: competitor metadata, keywords, screenshots, ratings, reviews, category rank, update cadence, IAP/subscriptions, In-App Events, CPP/ad patterns, ASO.dev App Info, App Clash, Spy, or competitor gap analysis.
skills.description_zh: 分析 App Store/Google Play 竞品元数据、关键词、截图、评分评价、类别排名、更新频率、内购订阅、活动、CPP 与广告模式及差距，支持 ASO.dev App Info/App Clash/Spy。

skills.name: cpp-ppo-pages
skills.description: Use when the user wants App Store Custom Product Pages, Product Page Optimization, A/B testing, conversion rate optimization, product page variants, screenshot/icon/app preview tests, campaign pages, keyword/ad alignment, or CPP/PPO drafts in ASO.dev.
headings: CPP, PPO, and Store Listing Tests
skills.description_zh: 规划 App Store 自定义产品页 CPP、产品页优化 PPO、A/B 测试和转化提升，涵盖截图图标预览变体、活动页、关键词广告对齐及 ASO.dev 草稿。

skills.name: current-metadata-fetch
skills.description: Use before editing current Apple or Google metadata in ASO.dev. Reads active editor data through the local MCP and returns a compact snapshot for ASO work.
skills.description_zh: 编辑 ASO.dev 当前 Apple/Google 元数据前，通过本地 MCP 读取活动编辑器内容，返回精简 ASO 快照。

skills.name: featuring-nomination
skills.description: Use when the user wants App Store featuring, Apple editorial consideration, App of the Day/Today tab ideas, launch/update nomination strategy, or ASO.dev featuring nomination drafts. Reads and fills nomination drafts through the local MCP when available.
skills.description_zh: 规划 App Store 编辑推荐、每日应用、Today 主题及发布更新提名，并起草 ASO.dev 推荐申请；本地 MCP 可用时读取和填写草稿。

skills.name: figma-json-localization
skills.description: Use when the user wants to localize a Figma or ASO.dev screenshot JSON file into all App Store Connect localizations, translate screenshot/UI text keys, use description/context fields, respect length limits, preserve JSON structure, and keep all system/template tags such as asodev{...}, {placeholder}, {{token}}, or <tag> unchanged.
skills.description_zh: 将 Figma 或 ASO.dev 截图 JSON 本地化至全部 App Store Connect 语言地区，翻译 UI 键并利用描述语境，遵守长度、保留结构，以及 asodev{...}、{placeholder}、{{token}} 和 <tag> 等系统模板标记。

skills.name: in-app-events
skills.description: Use when the user wants to create, plan, audit, optimize, localize, or fill App Store In-App Events in ASO.dev: event cards for Today/Games/Apps tabs, search, product pages, re-engagement, challenges, competitions, live events, premieres, seasons, major updates, and special events.
skills.description_zh: 在 ASO.dev 创建、规划、审计、优化、本地化或填写 App Store 应用内活动卡片，覆盖 Today/Games/Apps、搜索、产品页、再互动、挑战、赛事、直播、首映、赛季、更新及特别活动。

skills.name: in-app-purchases
skills.description: Use for App Store consumable and non-consumable In-App Purchases: metadata, localization, pricing/availability notes, promoted IAP readiness, validation, and ASO.dev local MCP fill when that surface is available.
skills.description_zh: 处理 App Store 消耗与非消耗型内购的元数据、本地化、价格可用性说明、推广就绪和验证；本地 MCP 支持该界面时填写。

skills.name: in-app-subscriptions
skills.description: Use for App Store auto-renewable subscriptions and subscription groups: product names, descriptions, trial/offer wording, localization, pricing/availability notes, validation, and ASO.dev local MCP fill when that surface is available.
skills.description_zh: 处理 App Store 自动续订产品及订阅组的名称描述、试用优惠文案、本地化、价格可用性和验证；本地 MCP 支持时填写。

skills.name: keyword-coverage
skills.description: Use for keyword ideas, keyword prioritization, keyword/search query CSV-derived shortlists, competitor keyword gaps, Search Ads Popularity interpretation, and keyword distribution across metadata/locales.
skills.description_zh: 提出及排序关键词，依据关键词或搜索查询 CSV 生成短名单，识别竞品缺口、解释 Search Ads Popularity，并安排跨元数据及地区分布。

skills.name: keyword-research
skills.description: Use when the user wants ASO keyword discovery or research: uploaded keyword/search query CSV analysis, Search Ads Popularity, keyword rankings, suggestions, difficulty, total app count, guided search, Search Term Rank Report, competitor keywords, keyword tracking lists, or ASO.dev Spy/Keywords data.
skills.description_zh: 研究 ASO 关键词，包括上传 CSV、Search Ads Popularity、排名、建议、难度、应用总数、引导搜索、Search Term Rank Report、竞品词及跟踪清单，使用 ASO.dev Spy/Keywords 数据。

skills.name: localization-cross-localization
skills.description: Use when the user wants to localize App Store or Google Play metadata, translate/adapt listings, expand to international markets, prioritize countries, adapt local keywords, localize screenshots, or use App Store cross-localization strategy.
skills.description_zh: 本地化及调整 App Store/Google Play 列表，规划国际市场、国家优先级、地区关键词与截图，并使用 App Store 跨地区本地化策略。

skills.name: metadata-editor
skills.description: Use when the user wants to write, rewrite, optimize, compare, validate, or bulk-fill Apple App Store or Google Play metadata in ASO.dev: title, subtitle, keyword field, description, promotional text, short description, full description, or What's New.
skills.description_zh: 在 ASO.dev 编写、重写、优化、比较、验证或批量填写 Apple/Google 标题、副标题、关键词、描述、促销文字、短长描述和版本更新。

skills.name: metadata-validation
skills.description: Use to validate ASO.dev Apple/Google metadata, In-App Event drafts, nominations, review replies, or review complaint drafts before filling them through the AI Companion MCP.
skills.description_zh: 通过 AI Companion MCP 填写前验证 Apple/Google 元数据、应用内活动、推荐申请、评价回复及申诉草稿。

skills.name: monetization-strategy
skills.description: Use when the user wants to design or optimize app monetization: pricing, paywalls, subscriptions, in-app purchases, free trials, intro offers, revenue optimization, conversion to paid, paid app strategy, freemium strategy, or ads/IAP/subscription mix.
skills.description_zh: 设计优化应用变现，包括价格、付费墙、订阅、内购、免费试用、首购优惠、付费转化、付费应用、免费增值及广告内购订阅组合。

skills.name: pricing-availability
skills.description: Use for App Store app, IAP, and subscription pricing or availability: price points, territory rollout, scheduled changes, regional availability, offer pricing, ASO.dev CSV price templates, validation, and ASO.dev local MCP fill when that surface is available.
skills.description_zh: 处理 App Store 应用、内购和订阅的价格与可用性，包括价位、地区上线、计划变更、优惠及 ASO.dev CSV 价格模板和验证；本地 MCP 支持时填写。

skills.name: reviews-ratings
skills.description: Use when the user wants to analyze, respond to, report, or improve App Store reviews and ratings in ASO.dev: negative reviews, ratings trend, review replies, review complaints, review health, product insights, uploaded review CSV analysis, sentiment, missing feature requests, or rating prompt strategy.
skills.description_zh: 在 ASO.dev 分析、回复、举报或改善 App Store 评价评分，涵盖负评、趋势、申诉、健康度、产品洞察、上传 CSV、情绪、缺失功能和评分提示策略。

skills.name: screenshot-brief
skills.description: Use to prepare screenshot copy, screenshot order, creative briefs, and App Store / Google Play visual messaging.
skills.description_zh: 为 App Store/Google Play 准备截图文案、顺序、创意简报和视觉信息表达。

skills.name: seasonal-calendar
skills.description: Use when the user wants seasonal ASO, holiday optimization, trending moments, seasonal keywords, metadata swaps, promotional text, screenshots, In-App Events, CPP/PPO, Google Calendar/Apple Calendar planning, or timing/revert strategy around calendar events.
skills.description_zh: 围绕节日和趋势安排季节性 ASO、关键词、元数据切换、促销文字、截图、活动及 CPP/PPO，支持 Google/Apple 日历规划、实施及恢复时点。

skills.name: subscription-lifecycle
skills.description: Use when the user wants to optimize subscription lifecycle and subscriber retention: trial start, trial conversion, renewal, churn, cancellation, grace period, billing retry, dunning, win-back offers, lapsed subscribers, subscriber LTV, renewal rate, or resubscribe strategy.
skills.description_zh: 优化订阅生命周期及留存，覆盖试用开始转化、续订、流失取消、宽限期、扣款重试催收、挽回优惠、失效订阅者、LTV、续订率及重新订阅。

skills.name: whats-new-release-notes
skills.description: Use to write App Store What's New / release notes for updates, bug fixes, new features, and launch communication.
skills.description_zh: 为应用更新、缺陷修复、新功能和发布沟通编写 App Store What's New 及版本说明。
